patthana12.9:1.1: Noāsavaṃ nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe… nanoāsavaṃ nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca….
patthana12.9:2.1: Nasāsavaṃ nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe… naanāsavaṃ nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca….
patthana12.9:3.1: Naāsavasampayuttaṃ nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe… naāsavavippayuttaṃ nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca….
patthana12.9:4.1: Naāsavañceva naanāsavaṃ nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe… naanāsavañceva nano ca āsavaṃ nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca….
patthana12.9:6.1: Naāsavavippayuttañceva nano ca āsavaṃ nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe… āsavavippayuttaṃ nasāsavaṃ nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe… āsavavippayuttaṃ naanāsavaṃ nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca….
